concerns.text: The plan states “Only the two URLs listed in the “Verified datasets” block are cited.” but the document contains no “Verified datasets” block, making the compliance claim unverifiable and violating Principle II.

The data‑model defines an entity **AnalysisSummary**, yet the plan never mentions generating or using this artifact (e.g., a consolidated JSON summary). All other entities are referenced, so the plan is missing a required output.

The contract schema (contracts/detection_results.schema.yaml) requires a `sha256` column in every detection result row, but the plan’s description of `tide_lite_enriched.csv` and `tide_original_enriched.csv` does not explicitly state that this column will be included.
